fields.title: Daily Greetings
fields.description: Common phrases used every day — perfect for beginners
fields.content: Good morning. How are you today? I am doing very well thank you. The weather is nice today. I would like a cup of tea please. Have a good day.

fields.title: At the Market
fields.content: How much does this cost? That is very expensive. Can you give me a better price? I will think about it. Thank you very much.

fields.title: Introducing Yourself
fields.description: Professional self-introduction for interviews and meetings
fields.content: My name is Ahmed and I am a software engineering student at MUET. I am particularly interested in artificial intelligence and mobile application development. I have experience working with Python, Flutter, and Django. I am looking for opportunities to apply my skills in a professional environment. I am a quick learner and I work well in a team.

fields.title: Describing Your Project
fields.description: Technical explanation suitable for viva and presentations
fields.content: Our system is designed to improve English pronunciation for Pakistani learners. The application listens to the user reading a script and identifies mispronounced words. We use artificial intelligence models to compare the user's speech with the correct pronunciation. Immediate feedback is provided through both audio and text. The system is free, works offline, and runs on any Android or iOS device.

fields.title: Technology and Society
fields.description: Extended passage for advanced fluency and pronunciation practice
fields.content: Artificial intelligence is transforming the way we communicate, learn, and work. In education particularly, intelligent systems are enabling personalized learning at a scale that was previously impossible. Students in remote areas can now access the same quality of instruction as those in well-resourced urban centers. However, the responsible development of these technologies requires careful consideration of privacy, equity, and the long-term impact on human skills. As future engineers, it is our responsibility to build systems that benefit everyone.

fields.title: Hugging Face warning
fields.content: you can ignore this warning, when you load a pre-trained model like wav2vec2-base-960h using the transformers library, hugging face runs a strict check on the architecture. Sometimes, newer versions of the library have slightly renamed layers (like weight-g vs weight), or they include blank layers for training that aren't needed for just listening

fields.title: Good Morning Introduction
fields.content: Good morning everyone. My name is Ahmed. I am happy to be here today. Thank you for giving me this opportunity to speak. I hope you enjoy my talk.

fields.title: Talking About Yourself
fields.content: Hello. My name is Sara and I am a student. I study at Mehran University. I like reading books and learning new things. I want to improve my English speaking skills. Thank you for listening to me.

fields.title: Benefits of Technology
fields.description: Short speech about technology in everyday life
fields.content: Technology has changed the way we live and work. Today we use smartphones, computers, and the internet every day. These tools help us communicate faster and learn more easily. However, we must use technology responsibly. We should make sure it helps us rather than distracts us. Thank you.

fields.title: Conference Opening
fields.content: Hello. How are you today. It is great to see you again. I hope you are doing well and enjoying your day. Welcome to our annual conference on technology and innovation. We have an exciting program prepared for you today. I am confident you will find the sessions both informative and inspiring.

fields.title: The Importance of Education
fields.description: Persuasive speech on education for society
fields.content: Education is the foundation of every successful society. When people have access to quality education, they can improve their lives and contribute meaningfully to their communities. In Pakistan, we must invest more in our schools and universities. We must ensure that every child, regardless of their background, has the opportunity to learn and grow. Education is not just a right. It is a responsibility we share as a nation.

fields.title: Presenting a Project
fields.description: Technical project presentation at university level
fields.content: Good afternoon. Today I will present our final year project, PronounceMate. PronounceMate is an artificial intelligence system that helps learners improve their English pronunciation in real time. The system listens to the user's speech, identifies mispronounced words, and delivers immediate corrective feedback. We used Faster-Whisper for speech recognition and wav2vec for acoustic analysis. Our evaluation shows a Pearson Correlation Coefficient of above zero point six five against human expert scores on the SpeechOcean benchmark.

fields.title: Leadership and Responsibility
fields.content: Distinguished guests, colleagues, and fellow students. True leadership is not about authority or position. It is about the willingness to serve, to listen, and to take responsibility when things go wrong rather than when things go right. The most effective leaders I have encountered throughout my career share one defining characteristic. They measure their success not by personal achievement but by the growth and development of the people around them. That is the kind of leadership our country needs today.

fields.title: Artificial Intelligence and Society
fields.description: Advanced discourse on AI ethics and impact
fields.content: As artificial intelligence continues to reshape the boundaries of what machines can accomplish, we find ourselves confronting profound questions about the future of human agency, creativity, and purpose. The promise of AI is extraordinary. Systems that can diagnose diseases with superhuman accuracy, predict climate patterns decades in advance, and accelerate scientific discovery across every discipline simultaneously. Yet the responsible development of these technologies demands that we proceed with both ambition and humility, recognizing that the consequences of our choices today will reverberate through generations we will never meet.

fields.title: Morning Greetings
fields.content: Good morning. How are you. I am fine thank you. Did you sleep well last night. Yes I slept very well. What are you doing today. I am going to the market. Have a good day.

fields.title: Ordering Food
fields.description: Conversation at a restaurant or cafe
fields.content: Can I see the menu please. I would like a cup of tea. Do you have anything to eat. Yes we have sandwiches and samosas. I will have a sandwich please. How much does it cost. It costs one hundred rupees. Thank you very much.

fields.title: At the University
fields.content: Have you finished the assignment yet. Not yet. I am still working on it. When is it due. It is due tomorrow morning. I think we should work on it together. That is a good idea. Let us meet in the library at five o'clock. Sure. I will see you there.

fields.title: Making Plans
fields.description: Arranging to meet a friend or colleague
fields.content: Are you free this weekend. I think so. What did you have in mind. I was thinking we could go to the park. That sounds great. What time were you thinking. How about Saturday afternoon around three o'clock. That works for me. Should I bring anything. Just bring yourself and your good mood. Perfect. I am looking forward to it.

fields.title: Discussing the News
fields.content: Did you see the news this morning. No I did not. What happened. There was a major announcement about the new education policy. Really. What did they say. The government plans to increase funding for public universities by thirty percent. That is actually quite significant. I hope it leads to real improvements in the quality of education. I agree. We have been waiting for this kind of investment for a long time.

fields.title: Career Discussion
fields.content: I have been thinking seriously about my career path lately. What specifically has been on your mind. I am trying to decide between pursuing a master's degree immediately or gaining some industry experience first. Both have their merits. What does your gut tell you. Honestly, I think the practical experience would make me a stronger candidate for a competitive graduate program later. That is a very mature way of looking at it. Have you spoken to anyone in the field about their perspective.

fields.title: Philosophical Discussion
fields.content: I have been reading about the concept of free will lately and I find myself increasingly skeptical about whether it actually exists. That is a fascinating rabbit hole. What specifically challenged your intuitions. The neuroscience research suggesting that our brains make decisions several hundred milliseconds before we become consciously aware of them. That is compelling but I would push back on the interpretation. Consciousness might not need to initiate the action to still meaningfully participate in it. That is an interesting distinction. Say more.
